create_evaluation_predictor: create an EvaluationPredictor instance wrapping a CoTrackerThreeOffline model with configurable grid and SIFT sampling options
run_evaluation_predictor_forward: run the EvaluationPredictor forward pass on a video tensor and query points to get trajectory and visibility predictions
process_single_point_tracking: process a single query point through the model using the _process_one_point method with local grid augmentation
configure_grid_sampling: configure the EvaluationPredictor with grid_size and local_grid_size parameters for grid-based point sampling during tracking
configure_sift_sampling: configure the EvaluationPredictor with sift_size and num_uniformly_sampled_pts parameters for SIFT and uniform point sampling
